resources.string: Sounds quieter than the threshold are ignored. Green bar = current input level: set the threshold just above the room noise.
High: piano, quiet and fading notes. Low: guitar or ukulele in a noisy room.
Filters the pitch itself: higher = fewer note jumps from noise, but slower to react.
Inertia of the pick on screen. 0 = follows the pitch instantly; higher = glides smoothly.
Mini tuner on the rear screen
Leave space for the camera island
